rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-evidence/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions`.

- **When to use it:** The `description` begins "Use when Habeas evidence needs creating or refreshing". It continues with the situations in which the user runs `habeas coverage` or `habeas status` and gets findings: missing, stale or false evidence, uncovered `{test}` lines, FIXME judgments, review findings, and disagreeing assessments. It also covers the user who only says "the habeas test is failing". This states when to use the skill in terms of the user's task.
- **Naming another skill:** The description says "If evidence went stale because code or requirements moved, use habeas-refactor first." The requirement allows this (MAY). `habeas-refactor` is a bundled skill, since `assets/skills/habeas-refactor` exists. It is a reasonable pointer, because an agent could confuse the two skills.

The site has no gap. The site query matched and no violation queries are listed.
